item.description:
Agents can drive Devkitty, browser hover fixed, smoother browser

  • Board AI: Claude, Codex and Cursor sessions in a Devkitty terminal can use the devkitty command. They can open a tab or workspace, split their pane and run a command there, open a browser page, and rename or set the icon of their workspace or tab. It works only in Devkitty terminals, with a secret key per session, on the session's own workspace only, at most 10 new tabs per minute. It cannot close, quit or list anything. Switch: Settings › Board AI › Let agent sessions control Devkitty.
  • Browser: hover and the hand cursor work again in focused pages and full browser tabs.
  • Browser: the URL bar slides down and up smoothly, and the page moves with it. The arrow tab that shows it has a normal arrow cursor.
  • Browser in a split: drag and close are in the URL bar. With the bar hidden, only the top-centre arrow shows, and one click opens the bar even if the pane is not focused.
  • Browser: every row in the Profile menu shows its icon.
  • Board: a Search cards box (Cmd-F). Restore brings back a card's saved tabs in one workspace.
  • Board: renaming a card renames its workspace tab, and a name you give a tab or workspace shows on its card instead of the AI title.
  • Board AI can give open cards their own icons and short names. It no longer picks a plain terminal or tool icon. Your own names and icons always win.
  • GitHub Actions: jobs from one reusable-workflow call show in one stage, like on GitHub.
